definitions.explanation: What is actually the case; the real state of affairs.

examples.japanese: {真実|しんじつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{明|あき}らかにする→明らかにする：22256_akirakanisuru⟧。
{真実|しんじつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{語|かた}る→語る：01930_kataru⟧。
{真実|しんじつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{愛|あい}→愛：02370_ai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけた→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧。

notes:
{真実|しんじつ} means truth or reality — the actual state of affairs, especially when it has been hidden or unknown. Composed of ⟦{真|しん}→真：28884_shin⟧ (true) + ⟦{実|じつ}→実：28344_jitsu⟧ (reality).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {真実|しんじつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}る→知る：00458_shiru⟧: to learn the truth
- {真実|しんじつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{明|あき}らかにする→明らかにする：22256_akirakanisuru⟧: to reveal the truth
- {真実|しんじつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{隠|かく}す→隠す：02034_kakusu⟧: to hide the truth
- {真実|しんじつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{愛|あい}→愛：02370_ai⟧: true love
- {真実|しんじつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迫|せま}る→迫る：03928_semaru⟧: to get close to the truth

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{事実|じじつ}→事実：03271_jijitsu⟧: fact (objective, verifiable)
- ⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧: truth, really (everyday)
- ⟦{真理|しんり}→真理：03333_shinri⟧: universal/philosophical truth
- ⟦{実態|じったい}→実態：10567_jittai⟧: actual state, reality (of a situation)

USAGE:
{真実|しんじつ} often implies something deeper or hidden that needs to be uncovered. ⟦{事実|じじつ}→事実：03271_jijitsu⟧ is more neutral and factual. ⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧ is the everyday word for "truth" or "really."
